data.gender_notes: Khemraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Khemraj is derived from two Sanskrit words, ‘Khema’ meaning 'earth' and ‘Raj’ meaning 'king' or 'ruler'. This name signifies the creator of the universe and the one who rules over it. The name Khemraj carries the meaning “God of creation” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Khemraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god of creation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine power that creates and sustains the universe.
data.etymology: Khemraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of creation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khemraj total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
